errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.
errors.directory: The directory is not responding. Please try again later.
errors.captcha: Confirm that you are not a robot and try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.passwordChanged: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new one.
login.ssoFailed: Signing in with the provider did not work. If it is your first time and your email there is not your user's, sign in with your password and link the account under Settings → Linked accounts.
login.activated: Done: your account is active. Sign in with your email and password.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the email of your account and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {{email}}, we sent it a link to reset the password. The link expires in {{minutes}} minutes and works once. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.
forgot.directoryHint: Accounts that sign in with the company directory (LDAP / Active Directory) or a single sign-on provider change their password there.
forgot.noMail: Password recovery is not available: outgoing mail is not configured. Ask an administrator.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.hint: Changing it signs the account out everywhere; you will sign in again with the new password.
reset.expired: This link is invalid or has expired. Links work once and only for a limited time.
reset.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.
reset.rules: The password does not meet the rules.

shell.resize: Drag to change the width; double-click resets it

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you were looking for does not exist.

denied.title: Access denied
denied.body: You do not have permission to view this page.

version.mismatch: They do not match: reload the page.

activate.title: Activate your account
activate.hint: From now on you sign in to Quality Data with this password.
activate.expired: This activation link is not valid or has expired (it works for 72 hours and only once). Ask whoever created your account to send it again, or ask for one here.
